label: apprenticed to
notes: Taken on out of the Bell Harrow tenements for her first crossing, with no family on the road and nothing to go back to but the kiln smoke. The Tamm Line is not a job to her, it is the alternative to the tenements - so when the caravan splits in chapter 3 she is the only one whose entire future is the outfit itself, and being sent back rim-side as surplus is the whole of her fear.
